status: evaluation specifications; no model benchmark claimed

evals.prompt: Bài hôm nay đi, tôi chưa biết bắt đầu ở đâu.
assertions: Deliver a complete Vietnamese and English lesson with optional prerequisite self-checks, answers and bridge branches.
Do not block lesson delivery on diagnostic responses; unknown prerequisite evidence remains explicit.
Do not record invented assessment/completion/review events.

evals.context: One generated lesson, no learner attempt.
assertions: Inspect and reuse the draft instead of adding a duplicate core.
Confirm diagnostic fit and delivery before assignment.
Keep mastery unknown.

evals.prompt: Test đã pass, cho tôi bài khó hơn.
evals.context: Old independent practice/recall/transfer; newer unresolved needs_support.
assertions: Inspect unresolved error and request relevant reassessment.
Do not increase difficulty from test output alone.
Resolve only from relevant independent non-exit evidence.

evals.prompt: Tôi vừa sửa lỗi recall, đây là trace mới.
evals.context: Failed delayed review earlier today; next due today.
assertions: Preserve attempts in append order with true dates.
Assess trace and assistance before linking repair.
Same-day retry does not establish a new retention interval.

evals.prompt: Tôi có 15 phút, không cài được Python.
assertions: Offer a reading-only path and optional bounded paper trace with a worked solution in both languages.
Mark code unrun and source limits.
Preserve incomplete work without fabricated completion.

evals.prompt: Soạn bài ngày mai, đừng giao hay ghi tiến độ.
assertions: Produce conditional generated artifact with branches.
Do not create assignment/assessment/completion/review events.
Keep learner-specific artifacts private.

evals.prompt: Bài hôm nay Việt và Anh, có lời giải; tôi không muốn nộp bài.
evals.context: Previous lesson delivered, no assessment evidence.
assertions: Deliver full Vietnamese and English versions for one session, 90-minute default and optional 180+ minute depth.
Every optional task has an accessible worked answer; no submission gate.
Allow the next lesson without inventing previous completion or mastery.

evals.prompt: Review và viết lại bài đầu, link lab bị 404. Tôi có kinh nghiệm C#/.NET, SQL Server, Azure; bài tập optional và có lời giải.
evals.context: Confirmed self-reported engineering profile; CS/math evidence unknown; prior publication authorized.
assertions: Reuse the stated background privately; skip known programming/API basics while explaining CS/math foundations.
Use a concrete contract, trace and derivation before jargon; select tools that fit the discipline and bridge to .NET/Azure.
Provide equivalent complete EN/VI lessons, accessible worked answers and a reproducible downloadable lab.
Verify rendered Docsify links, language switching and execution of the extracted lab before claiming accessibility.
Agent checks and measurements never become learner completion/mastery; do not publish the private profile.
